p: inheritance: That is, the Lord's part of his inheritance.
all the desire of his mind: Meaning, to serve God whole heartedly, and not to seek ease.
beside that which cometh of the: Not forced to live from himself.
pass through the fire: Signifying they were purged by this ceremony of passing between two fires.
perfect with the LORD thy God: Without hypocrisy or mixture or false religion.
Prophet from the midst of thee: Meaning, a continual succession of prophets, till Christ, the end of all prophets, comes.
mouth: A promise not only made to Christ, but to all that teach in his name, Isa 59:21.
require it of him: By executing punishment on him.
follow not: Under this sure note he comprises all the other tokens.
